canonical_title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT for Teens with automatic age-based protections and parental controls
treatment: Covered as the formal product launch. Reinclude only for material changes to age estimation, safeguards, parental-control capabilities, geographic availability, enforcement behavior, or credible evidence of significant safety failures.
known_facts: OpenAI launched ChatGPT for Teens on August 18, 2026.
The teen experience activates when a user is estimated to be under 18 or self-identifies as 13 to 17.
OpenAI says it defaults to the safer teen setting when age is uncertain.
Parents can set Quiet Hours, manage selected settings, and receive limited alerts around sensitive-topic discussions.
The teen experience adds restrictions around high-risk topics including self-harm, violence and eating disorders and includes guided-learning tools.
reinclude_only_if: OpenAI materially changes age-prediction or verification behavior.
OpenAI expands or removes major parental controls or teen safeguards.
A regulator, court, or credible technical investigation establishes a material safety or privacy issue.
notes: Formal launch falls inside the 2026-08-18 12:00-23:30 JST night window.
